about: Quiz Board: 5 topics x 5 squares (1 to 5 points), one secret DOUBLE square. Questions come from Quiz Battle (games/quiz-battle/content.json) for the level, so there is nothing to write here except the How to play slides.

intro.title: Quiz Board
text: Teams take turns choosing a square.
Bigger numbers = harder questions, more points.

intro.title: Answer it
text: Every team writes or holds up an answer.

intro.title: DOUBLE!
text: One square is a secret DOUBLE.
It is worth twice the points!

intro.title: One team at a time
text: Sometimes only the team that chose answers.
Power-ups (once each): 50/50, +20 s, Free answer, Risk it!
